wording_rule: localized to the validator stage != mechanism understood. Candidates excluded, not proven absent.
standing_statement: The stages examined so far (extractor, postfilter, linker/worthiness) provide no explanation for the remaining silences. Inside the validator, the assertion scope was excluded as an explanation for the recipient rejections, while a separate scope effect on explicit support predicates was demonstrated. The mechanism behind the recipient rejections remains open.

material_defect_ledger.handling: excluded from valid recipient analysis and postfilter replay; no rerun, no prompt change, no result rewriting

pipeline_localization_v8.extractor: not explained; 14 controlled factors show no systematic silence effect
pipeline_localization_v8.postfilter: no hard drop: 15 ACCEPT / 10 WARN / 3 ABSTAIN / 0 REJECT of 28 validator-ACCEPT items
pipeline_localization_v8.linker_worthiness: no drop; documented selection preferences only

validator_phenomenon_1_support_predicate.status: demonstrated observation, not a proposed change

validator_phenomenon_2_recipient_rejecti.status: MECHANISM OPEN; deliberately not further decomposed inside batch-6 material

probe_addendum.verdict: H-SCOPE not supported; recipient mechanism remains open

not_concluded: no prompt change is proposed or made
the 26 A-ACCEPT -> B-REJECT transitions are not evidence for prompt tuning
